title: Planned NBN maintenance – Merrimac and Southport (QLD)
current_summary: Planned maintenance will replace backhaul fibre serving the NBN areas of Merrimac and Southport (QLD). Some NBN services may experience interruptions of up to 7 hours during the window on 20 Oct 2026 from 00:00 to 06:30 (Queensland time).

cause.reason: Fibre cable replacement by a network provider

updates.content: A network provider will undertake planned maintenance to replace backhaul fibre serving the NBN areas of Merrimac and Southport. This work is scheduled for 20 Oct 2026 from 00:00 to 06:30 (Queensland time). During this window, some NBN services in these areas may be interrupted for up to 7 hours. We will monitor the activity and provide updates if anything changes.
